QuestInfo.name: [Beasts of Fury] The Banquet Begins
QuestInfo.0: The banquet with the Gold Dragon members will begin soon.
QuestInfo.1: Delicious food and drinks! Merry people! Everyone worked hard for this banquet, so it's time to enjoy it all.
QuestInfo.2: The moment the two masters took their first bite of the food, they both collapsed!
